key_insight: BrainNext is a self-supervised 3D foundation model that learns transferable brain MRI representations from large unlabeled data and adapts well to multiple downstream tasks.
clinical_relevance: It may support more accurate and scalable brain MRI analysis across classification, segmentation, and brain-age estimation, with potential to reduce task-specific model development.
method: Pretrained with masked autoencoder (MAE) self-supervised learning on 60,551 unlabeled brain MRI exams.
Uses a native 3D Bi-Directional xLSTM-UNet architecture for volumetric representation learning.
Fine-tuned lightly for downstream tasks after pretraining.
evidence_signal: In the FOMO 2025 Method Track, BrainNext achieved second place overall and first place for meningioma segmentation on the official leaderboard.
watch_item: Results are promising, but broader real-world validation across sites, scanners, and patient populations is still needed before routine deployment.
paper_title: BrainNext: A General-Purpose Self-Supervised Foundation Model for Brain MRI Analysis
